notes.title: Teenage Blob goes Full Blast!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/702ca2ad2217ffc3ad141ead81e8406589070e30.gif[/img]
Announced during our performance at the incredible SAVE & SOUND festival, Full Blast is the latest Teenage blob major update, and it's a doozy! 
[previewyoutube=bqUkUhTd6vQ;full][/previewyoutube]

With a heavy emphasis on the sonic side of things, we've crammed a bunch of awesome new treats into Teenage Blob Full Blast! 

Highlights include:
[list]
[*] More Clothes! 12 New items for your wardrobe!
[*] More Boots! 4 fresh treats for your feets!
[*] More Songs! 16 new tracks w/ instrumental, live & demo versions of Teenage Blob!
[*] Blobamp! Our in game homage the MP3 player that sound-tracked our teen years!
[*] Red hot graphic updates!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/2278df0537ba5d46a71050b64e41f80e0d9cc8cd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/2b71b862344d98bff7b3fc85bd6b3c6d2d0a9612.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/133dfe4dcc3545f6bffc32d7662269564e7450c3.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/b76f29930ff53039d8734f93f763ed9c73f79296.gif[/img]

If you've been waiting for the right time to get your Blob on (or are looking for a great excuse to return to the Blob World!) there's never been a better time to make that happen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/885db2a888f5e4cccf999c951adba42b5b66e631.png[/img]
Thanks to SAVE AND SOUND for giving us such a great platform to share this good news! We're so happy that we could perform at the event, and that The Superweaks "Live at SAVE & SOUND" recordings will forever be a part of Teenage Blob going forward!

We hope everyone will have a great time with all these new additions to Teenage Blob! If you do Blob out, please consider leaving us a review! For a tiny punk game, it means so much to us!

Thanks for reading!

Be excellent to each other!
<3 Team Lazerbeam & The Superweaks!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/9162766ff50eff54c6bcc60b2e491e5747487073.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teenage Blob "Extended Play" update out now!
notes.content:
Team Lazerbeam and The Sperweaks are massively stoked to announce the release of Teenage Blob's "Extended Play" update! 

The first major update to our colourful art punk adventure, Extended Play is crammed full of new features and improvements!

[b]New Game Plus! [/b]
Unlocked after completing your first playthrough, New Game Plus significantly expands on the original Teenage Blob experience. Players can now play games in any order, and repeat play  individual tracks to their heart’s content.     

[b]Live Mode[/b]
Play along to a live version of Teenage Blob’s soundtrack! With recordings from their iconic “Live at A MAZE 2020” performance, the live versions of Teenage Blob’s 6 games let you ride, skate and riff along with The Superweaks as they tear things apart!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/7f8da3dbd1cdcf65e86cafc88e5d23e031086fee.gif[/img]
[b]Zine reader: [/b]
A special treat for owners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15850/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]Teenage Blob Special Edition[/url], this one lets you read your zine from the game’s main menu!  

[b]Hand crafted localization![/b]
More than one hundred new assets have been hand-crafted to give all players the ultimate Teenage Blob experience! Witness our handmade art in Japanese, Russian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Spanish and French!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/4470ee2fcc8cef88f0031f6106325df62a2063b3.gif[/img]

[b]Dozens of improvements and bug fixes: [/b]
Experience a refined-blob-economy! Enjoy fully functional achievements and look back on your victories with our in game achievement viewer! Skate through the reworked streets of Capeadelphia! Shred along with tighter directions on Guitar Zero! Marvel at Extended Play's multiple quality of life improvements!  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/83227fecb76f75c16012af65203501f9b8ff24de.jpg[/img]
There's more to discover in game, so make your weekend more radical and give Teenage Blob: Expanded a spin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/aeb52114676d4981951fec608e9467ada2b38caf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teenage Blob is out!
notes.content:
Good news everyone: [b]Teenage Blob is out![/b] After 3+ years of blob, sweat and tears, our colorful art-punk adventure has finally been released! You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096060/Teenage_Blob/]download the split right now[/url], relive the magic of going to a gig, and get in on what has to be one of the weirdest creations to ever hit Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/84631c39fd4e8ce087e26263304cc60d8e2f2a81.jpg[/img]

An unprecedented music/ game split is bound to confuse some people, but we’ve been massively encouraged by how well Teenage Blob has been received by both press and players. A bunch of cool videos and reviews have been created. There are too many highlights to name them all, but here are a couple of our favorite articles:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.hyperlightup.com/teenage-blob-review/]9.5/10 review on  Hyper Light Up![/url] “If this ain’t a 30 minutes indie masterpiece, then I do not know what else qualifies as one”
[*][url=https://www.pcgamer.com/if-you-miss-live-music-teenage-blob-is-a-pc-game-punk-album-that-captures-the-spirit-of-the-show/]"Play This” feature on PC Gamer![/url] "Like a bunch of late night pizza box doodles come to life, an interactive music visualizer and virtual mosh pit for the socially-distanced crowd desperately missing live music"
[*] [url=https://www.indiegamewebsite.com/2020/08/13/teenage-blob-review/]9/10 on Indie Game Website![/url] "It’s cute. It’s heartwarming. It’s a blast back to the days when you still had the energy and hormones to run around town.”
[/list]

There’s heaps more - far too much to cram into one blob blog! Sufice to say, it's been incredible seeing the split striking a chord with people all over The World! We felt so inspired, that we even included some of blob glowing press coverage in our brand new launch trailer. What else could we do when Kotaku called teenage blob "weird as f#$@*"?! (Warning: this trailer is loud!)

[previewyoutube=3yJxmYrsrR0;full][/previewyoutube]

Along with the main split, we’re also very happy to have[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15850/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/] launched the Teenage Blob Special Edition![/url] The SE features a 24 page zine, live versions of all Teenage Blob songs and a pack of wallpapers. If you’d like to show us some extra love (and bag a bunch of sweet blob treats) then the special edition is for you! If you already have a Standard Edition, you can also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1394980/Teenage_Blob_Special_Edition/]upgrade to Special Edition for a few bucks![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37835583/b390303f77317069af0481a2b3de438a370b816c.png[/img]

Thank you so much to everyone who’s supported and encouraged us over the years that we’ve spent making Teenage Blob. We’re so grateful for everyone that’s played a part in helping make our blobby dreams a reality!

[b]  Love and high-fives!
 Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks
[/b]

notes.title: Teenage Blob: PMA AMA
notes.content:
Teenage Blob, is The World's very first music/ game split release, and being such a new concept it seems to raise of lot of questions. What does a hybrid release like this play like? Where the heck did the concept come from? How did Team Lazerbeam and The Superweaks go about bringing this crazy concept to life?

We're super excited to be hosting "PMA AMA" as a special event designed to answer all these questions, and any others that folks might have! Not only that, but over the time of this AMA session we're gonna be taking any kind of request that we can realistically satisfy over our stream! Wanna ask The Superweaks to jam out a song about your dog? Want Team Lazerbeam to draw you as a blob? All this, and more, can become a reality if you tune into PMA AMA!

[b]Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/9Xh3HAE]our Discord[/url], & ask us about:[/b]
[list]
[*] The making of Teenage Blob!
[*] Playing in a music/ game band!
[*] Video games as the future of punk rock!
[*] How we teamed up with SUPERHOT PRESENTS!
[*] Being underground game punx!
[*] Breaking into the mainstream to make our Steam debut!
[/list]

[b]We'll also welcome any requests, including asking us to:[/b]
[list]
[*] Write you a song!
[*] Draw you a picture!
[*] Show you how to play tunes from Teenage Blob!
[*] Explain how to make hot sauce!
[*] Perform improvised dance routines!
[*] Show you our adorable pets!
[/list]

We can't wait to do this AMA session with all of you! Be sure to set a reminder for this event, and [url=https://discord.com/invite/9Xh3HAE]join the Discord[/url], so you can submit your questions and requests.

Till then, be excellent to each other!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/b8e0a08a0efd27bb6de3afb3c975aefe64e2b4db.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Teenage Blob Variety Show
notes.content:
Teenage Blob might just be the weirdest upcoming Steam Release. Half game, half album, Teen Blob blazes a new path offering a glimpse of a future where punk games and indie rock collide.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/b8e0a08a0efd27bb6de3afb3c975aefe64e2b4db.gif[/img]

To celebrate Teeanage Blob's participation Steam Summer Games fest, it's creators have put together a unique variety show! 

Expect: 
[list]
[*]Live music from The Superweaks, performing live versions of select Teenage Blob songs!
[*]Live game dev with Team Lazerbeam! 
[*] "The People's History of Teenage Blob" - the decade long story behind teen Blob, as told by the bands that made it!
[*] "The Shape Of Punk To Come 2020" a mini update on Team Lazerbeam's manifesto and blueprint for the future of subversive games!
[*] Exclusive sneak peeks of Teenage Blob
[*] Laffs, gaffs, goofs AND MORE!
[/list]

If you'd like to tune in for The Teenage Variety Show, be sure to hit the "Set Reminder" button so you don't miss out!

We can't wait to share all this cool stuff with you. Till then!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37835583/de04ae92848f80971e4c0bedb6db116e8248c1bb.gif[/img]
